title: Review readiness
intro: Review the grading state and the evidence before applying or delivering grades.

steps.review: Drafts can be reviewed before every input has a note. A written grade is distinct from a proposed grade.
steps.verify: Open an activity with both drafts and pending inputs; the primary action should open a ready draft and the gradebook count should include only recorded scores.
steps.say: Drafts can be reviewed before every input has a note. A written grade is distinct from a proposed grade.

steps.review: Inputs without CSV rows appear in this queue. Identity conflicts and invalid proposals remain held.
steps.verify: Use Show to switch between ready drafts, source holds and missing drafts. Open a row and confirm a held row cannot be approved.
steps.say: Inputs without CSV rows appear in this queue. Identity conflicts and invalid proposals remain held.
